eyebrow.purpose: Uppercase kicker labels above headings, tinted Network Blue.

readable-body.purpose: Long-form prose inside .readable containers (About, Legal Notice).

shadows.name: interactive-lift
shadows.purpose: Tailwind shadow-md; marks buttons, cards, and highlight boxes as interactive or notable. Deliberately sparing per the current flat-by-default baseline.

shadows.name: badge-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts the hexagon icon badge off the page.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action button; scales down on press, shifts to Deep MOPRED Teal on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: fit-content; padding: 8px 24px; border-radius: 4px; background: #b3f1ff; color: #000; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #00618f; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.9); } .ds-btn-icon { margin-left: 8px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Inline metadata label with the hashtag prefix convention.

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header navigation link; underline grows from 0 to full width on hover, stays full width when active.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; color: #fff; font-weight: 400; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 4px; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -4px; width: 0; height: 1px; background: #f5f5f5; transition: width 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { width: 100%; } .ds-nav-link.is-active::after { width: 100%; }

components.name: Timeline Card
components.description: History/timeline entry, alternating left/right along a connector line.
components.html:
10.10.2023

First Symposium

Over 100 researchers joined the first MOPRED symposium in Frankfurt.
components.css: .ds-timeline-card { background: #00618f; color: #fff; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-timeline-date { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 300; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-timeline-title { font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 1rem; } .ds-timeline-body { line-height: 1.2; text-align: justify; }

components.name: Highlight Detail Box
components.description: Icon + text metadata panel, e.g. event date/location on an event hero.
components.css: .ds-highlight-box { width: fit-content; padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: #e6f2f8; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-highlight-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }

components.name: Hexagon Icon Badge
components.description: Signature hexagonal clip-path icon container; the system's Molecular Network motif.
components.css: .ds-hex-badge { width: 5rem; height: 6.25rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #4b8ec0; clip-path: polygon(0% 25%, 0% 75%, 50% 100%, 100% 75%, 100% 25%, 50% 0%); filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)) drop-shadow(0 4px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)); }

narrative.overview:
MOPRED presents itself as a structural, data-connective system rather than a marketing surface: monospace type reads like output from a research instrument, hexagonal icon badges echo molecular/lattice geometry, and a literal connector-and-node timeline traces the consortium's history as a network of linked events. The system is precise but not cold — buttons compress on press, navigation links grow an underline on hover, and section headers alternate between left- and right-aligned compositions rather than settling into a single rigid grid. It reads as a working scientific tool built by and for a collaborative research community, not a generic institutional brochure.

The system deliberately avoids the generic corporate/SaaS register: no soft gradient hero banners, no interchangeable stock-photo blue-and-white dashboards. Where imagery appears (hero photo, graphical abstract), it sits inside precise rounded containers rather than bleeding into decorative backgrounds.
keyCharacteristics: Monospace-first typography, with a deliberate serif/sans switch (.readable) for long-form prose sections
Hexagonal icon badges as the system's signature geometric motif
Hashtag-prefixed tags and labels (#Symposium, #OrganizerName) used as a recurring metadata convention
A literal node-and-connector timeline for chronological/history content
Tactile, responsive micro-interactions on every actionable element
Deliberately asymmetric section headers (right-aligned on desktop) rather than a single centered convention

rules.name: The Hashtag Rule
rules.body: Any place metadata is listed inline — event tags, organizer names, topic lists — is prefixed with a Pale Cyan #. It is the system's consistent way of marking "this is a label, not prose."

rules.name: The Readable Override Rule
rules.body: Inside a .readable container, body text switches to the sans-serif stack for comfortable long-form reading, but h1, h2, and h6 stay on the monospace stack — headings keep the system's identity even where prose softens.

rules.name: The Semantic Spacing Rule
rules.body: Vertical spacing is chosen by semantic role (mb-section, mb-heading, mb-paragraph, ...) via CSS custom properties, not by raw Tailwind spacing scale numbers — new layout work should extend this named scale rather than reaching for arbitrary spacing values.

dos: Do prefix inline metadata (tags, organizer names, topic labels) with a Pale Cyan # (the Hashtag Rule).
Do give every interactive element a tactile reaction on press/hover (button active:scale-90, nav underline growth) — nothing should feel visually static when touched.
Do use the hexagon clip-path exclusively for icon badges; it is the system's one signature non-rectangular shape and loses its meaning if applied broadly.
Do use the named spacing scale (mb-section, mb-heading, etc.) for vertical rhythm rather than arbitrary spacing utilities.
Do keep headings on the monospace stack even inside .readable long-form sections (the Readable Override Rule).
donts: Don't default to a generic corporate/SaaS look — no soft gradient hero banners, no interchangeable stock-photo dashboards; this was explicitly named as an anti-reference.
Don't apply heavy, ambient, or decorative shadows everywhere — elevation stays a deliberate signal, even as the system moves toward "a bit more depth" in future passes.
Don't turn tags/labels into pill-shaped chips with background fills; the hashtag-prefixed plain-text convention is the established pattern.
Don't center every section header uniformly; the established rhythm alternates left-aligned (mobile) and right-aligned (desktop) headers rather than defaulting to center.
